nodes.title: The Door Comes Down
nodes.summary: You kneel at the keyhole: lamp lit, the master's shoulder. The door falls to Nathaniel Yardley's blows, a key hits the carpet, Major Carrington pockets it and sends you below. Past the tallow box Reginald Fairbrother alone draws after ten, you climb back up his stairs; with Gideon Ashcombe bending the Major over the desk you see frozen window, dead grate, poker standing, and a yellow tallow stub among white wax. Fairbrother watched you climb.
nodes.image: a yellow tallow stub snuffed in the study's white-wax candlestick
who: the master's valet of forty years

nodes.title: Dinner for Seven
nodes.summary: Over the master's empty chair Major Carrington holds the table on Evangeline Davenport's recited eleven o'clock quarrel, promising the magistrate the nephew at thaw. You whisper to Millicent Gresham that her sherry glass stays unwashed until she gives the hour; between courses she does: ten past ten, fire high. Nathaniel Yardley, who saw you whisper, bolts for the stables and is dragged back half-frozen and locked in. By midnight Millicent tells the Major you pocket things.
nodes.image: the master's empty chair at the head of a table nobody eats from

nodes.title: The Rounds Walked Twice
nodes.summary: Past midnight you rewalk the murder night, counting doors: the quarrel at half past ten, the nephew crossing the yard at twenty to, one light on the back stairs at eleven, so Evangeline's eleven o'clock is a lie. At the nephew's door you show Reginald Fairbrother the candle box one short and threaten to set it before the heir at breakfast unless he gives the hour. He says nothing; before dawn he is at the Major's door.
nodes.image: the open candle box, eleven tallow candles where twelve should lie
who: the master's valet of forty years

nodes.title: The Thaw
nodes.summary: Eaves drip; the lodge-keeper wades up: a cart by noon. Major Carrington orders the carriage, tells breakfast that Reginald Fairbrother lit the young gentleman up at eleven; Fairbrother stays silent, and Nathaniel Yardley shouts through his door that the old man has turned. The Major bars you the first floor, sends Lavinia Netherby to rake the study grate and Gideon Ashcombe with the body to the ice house, and keeps your rounds for the drawing room.
nodes.image: the housemaid's pail and fresh scuttle going up the stairs you are forbidden
who: the master's valet of forty years

new_locations.name: the first-floor gallery
new_locations.kind: the upper landing outside the master's study and the guests' bedroom doors
new_locations.why: where the study door was broken down and where your night rounds pass every door whose hour must be fixed

new_locations.name: the back stairs
new_locations.kind: the servants' stair from below stairs to the far end of the gallery, with the candle box at its foot
new_locations.why: the stair nobody but the valet uses after ten; climbing it is both your evidence and your exposure

new_locations.name: the dining room
new_locations.kind: the ground-floor room where the household eats under the Major's eye
new_locations.why: where you serve and listen, and where the Major makes his announcements to the house

new_characters.label: the lodge-keeper
new_characters.wants: to report the state of the road and get back to his fire before the drifts close again
new_characters.holds: the only word from beyond the gates since the storm began
new_characters.why: someone must bring the news that the road will carry a cart by noon, which starts the Major's clock
